note: Edge majors on which the isolated helper suites (testing\browser\isolated.test.cjs and loopback.test.cjs) were requalified. A new major is added only by a card that ran node testing\browser\qualify\qualify.cjs --requalify on it and archived the passing report. There is no newer-is-fine rule and no wildcard; the list is never compared with a build number or a binary hash.
